messages:
elena: Quick sync — v2 migration lifecycle & open deps. TL;DR: need final owners for SDK shim, gateway routing, docs deprecation notice, and a canary schedule. Target cutover proposed: 2026-05-01. Who can confirm milestones and blockers?

`todd`: Gateway routing owner here. I can do the routing changes and the compatibility shim. Clarify fallback behavior: do we auto-fallback to v1 on 404/500 for 2 weeks, or should that be opt-in per customer?

`nisha`: SDK lead. We have two open PRs (#722, #725) that implement the streaming wire-change and the retry semantics. I need the final API contract for streaming frames from eng-runtime by EOW to land #725.

`kevin`: Infra/ops — canary capacity is a concern. For dedicated pools we'll need a reserve of ~2 nodes in us-west1 for the initial canary to avoid evictions. I'll schedule capacity, but want an exact canary shard list.

`elena`: Proposed rollout milestones:
- 2026-04-20: internal canary (10% traffic, infra + runtime)
- 2026-04-27: partner canary (selected customers)
- 2026-05-01: public cutover and v1 deprecation notice
Owners: SDK = nisha, Gateway = todd, Docs = maria, QA = sam, Rollout PM = elena. Ack if you accept.

`maria`: Docs owner here. I'll draft deprecation notice + migration guide. Need example curl snippets and the final error codes for v2 -> v1 fallback behavior.

`sam`: QA — I'll own the smoke/e2e tests. Please drop a small test matrix: streaming, sync, embeddings, and function-calls. Prefer feature-flagged runs so we can flip on/off quickly.

`nisha`: Will add a feature flag and env var: REDWOOD_V2_MIGRATION=true. Adding SDK opt-in as well: `client.options({ v2_migration: true })`. Planning to branch the client behavior behind that until partner canary is green.

`build-bot`: CI passed: SDK #722 (unit + lint).

`deploy-bot`: Canary deployment for gateway/v2 scheduled: 2026-04-20T03:00:00Z -> will notify channel at start + finish.

`todd`: About fallback: propose default for first 2 weeks -> automatic fallback (v1) on 5xx/404 for non-critical routes, but hard-fail for admin/management endpoints. We'll surface warnings in logs and metrics. Thoughts?

`kevin`: That works for infra. We'll emit an explicit header `X-Redwood-Fallback: v1` when fallback happens and log a metric `v2_fallback.count`. Ops will alert if fallback > 1% sustained.

`elena`: Action items captured:
- nisha: land API contract PR + feature flag by 2026-04-10
- todd: implement gateway fallback hooks + header by 2026-04-12
- maria: deprecation notice draft by 2026-04-08
- sam: test matrix and e2e harness ready by 2026-04-15
- kevin: reserve canary infra by 2026-04-18
I'll update the milestone doc and ping product/legal for the public notice once docs draft is ready.

`todd`: pinging owners on PRs: @nisha please review gateway shim PR when ready, I'll open a follow-up for header metrics.

`nisha`: ack. I'll link PRs here when I push. Also adding these example snippets to docs: 
```
# opt-in example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "X-Feature-Flags: REDWOOD_V2_MIGRATION" \\n  -d '{"model":"rw-v2", "prompt":"hi"}'
```

`maria`: perfect, I'll use that.

`elena`: One more ask — if any team expects breaking telemetry changes (metric renames, spans) call it out now so observability/alerts can be updated before canary.

`kevin`: Ops note: metrics changes should be submitted as infra PRs to `infra/observability` repo. I'll watch for them.

`sam`: I'll add regression cases for metrics continuity in the test plan.

`elena`: Great. If no objections, I'll lock the milestone and send a short async update to #product and #eng-ops tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
